```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# install.packages("fivethirtyeight")
library(fivethirtyeight)

candy <- fivethirtyeight::candy_rankings

candy <- candy |> 
  mutate(type = case_when(
    chocolate & fruity ~ "both",
    chocolate ~ "chocolate",
    fruity ~ "fruity",
    .default = "other"
  ))

candy1 <- candy |> 
  mutate(quantity_type = case_when(
    bar ~ "bar",
    pluribus ~ "pluribus",
    .default = NA_character_
  ))

# count(candy, type)
```

# Plots

## Row 1

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Bar Candies"

list(
  icon = "distribute-horizontal",
  color = "success",
  value = sum(candy$bar == "TRUE")
  )
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Pluribus Candies"

list(
  icon = "basket",
  color = "warning",
  value = sum(candy$pluribus == "TRUE")
    )
```

## Row 2

```{r}

bang_for_buck <- ggplot(candy, aes(pricepercent, winpercent, color = type, text = paste("Name:", competitorname))) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Price Percentage vs Win Percentage",
       x = "Price Percentage",
       y = "Win Percentage",
       color = "Type")


ggplotly(bang_for_buck)
```

```{r}

sugar_single_plurb <- ggplot(candy1[!is.na(candy1$quantity_type), ], aes(quantity_type, sugarpercent)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Quantity Type vs Sugar Percentage",
       x = "Quantity Type",
       y = "Sugar Percent"
      )


ggplotly(sugar_single_plurb)
```
